title: Car Thing Vitals
tagline: It was made for Spotify in a car. Now it watches my servers.
what: The Car Thing is a small screen made for Spotify in a car. Mine sits on my desk running an app I wrote: one glance shows whether my servers, storage, graphics card and AI accounts are all okay.
built: Wrote the Vitals app for the Car Thing's 800 by 480 screen: servers, storage, graphics card and service health
Moved the data gathering into one service, so the Car Thing, the wall projector and phone share one feed
Tap the screen to switch AI accounts, or flip my PC between work and gaming
Made the layout fit the Car Thing's older browser, with room between every readout
credit: Built it, on top of DeskThing

making.problem: I wanted an "is my stuff working" board I could take in at a glance, without opening anything.
how: DeskThing lets third-party apps run on the Car Thing; my app is a server plus a React screen.
The Car Thing only reaches my network through the PC it is plugged into, so everything is fetched on the PC and images are sent inline.
The app doesn't fetch anything itself any more: it listens to one shared feed that also drives the wall and phone readouts.

proof.caption: The Vitals screen: servers, storage and the graphics card in one view.

credits: Platform: DeskThing and the Spotify Car Thing
